hypotheses: H-009 is rejected unless temporal, rolling, LOYO, exposure-normalized, neighboring-definition, right-tail, and implementation diagnostics jointly overturn EXP-P7-003.
H-010 is supported if no coarse stable PIT relationship survives the fixed audit and V1-R remains explanatory only.

known_before_freeze.boundary: Phase 7 block/year results are already known. The exact rolling, expanding, no-refit LOYO, frequency, beta-timing, cost, implementation, and ten-challenge outputs have not been calculated before this freeze.

sample.nav_semantics: Three independent bounded NAV blocks. Never chain across blocks.

fixed_diagnostics.yearly: Candidate minus control calendar-year return, max drawdown, exposure, severe-loss rate, and winner counts; exact equality is neutral.
fixed_diagnostics.rolling: All overlapping 126- and 252-session windows within each independent block, using NAV[end]/NAV[end-window]-1 for each arm and candidate minus control active return.
fixed_diagnostics.expanding: Within-block prefixes ending at each calendar year end, each starting from that block's independent initial capital; never chain blocks.
fixed_diagnostics.loyo: For each omitted calendar year, arithmetic mean/median and signs of the remaining seven annual active-return deltas. No parameter refit exists; this is a stability diagnostic, not OOS performance.
fixed_diagnostics.regime_frequency: By year, raw breadth_above_ma20 valid/missing fractions and fractions below/at-or-above 0.40 among valid sessions.
fixed_diagnostics.neighbor_sensitivity: Compare all frozen arms to the same control by calendar year. Never replace the primary after results.
fixed_diagnostics.exposure_and_tails: Block return/drawdown/exposure/turnover/cost/exposure-normalized deltas; ex-best5/10/20; severe losses; winner20/50; inherited baseline winner and Top-20 capture.
fixed_diagnostics.cost_sensitivity: 0/10/25/50 bps per filled side using frozen filled notional and a non-endogenous additive ledger adjustment. It is explicitly not an exact cash/share-path replay.
fixed_diagnostics.beta_timing: OLS with intercept of same-day portfolio return on 399102 index_return_1d, by block and pooled with lineage; report active alpha/beta and active returns on index-up/down days. This is descriptive and cannot be a strategy input.
fixed_diagnostics.implementation: Rehash all 15 ledgers; verify three C0 gates, completed-close availability, first-applicable date, no same-day fill, exact new-buy target weight, missing-input fail-closed behavior, overlay identity, and zero signal/rank/exit changes.

decision_rule: Candidate remains rejected if EXP-P7-003 failed promotion or any required Phase 8 robustness component fails. A neighbor may never replace the primary. H-010 is supported when the candidate remains rejected and the regime evidence is retained only as explanation.
oos_boundary: All 2018-2025 outcomes were already consumed before V1-R design. No untouched OOS exists. The 2022-2023 block is not called V1-R OOS. Walk-forward selection is infeasible because there is no untouched period and no trained/fitted model.
forbidden: selecting a neighbor as the new primary
naive chaining of independent NAV blocks
claiming rolling, expanding, or LOYO diagnostics are untouched OOS
claiming ledger-notional cost sensitivity is an exact endogenous replay
